work_completed: Added GET /api/models (mvp/api/models.ts, src/agent/models-route.ts): lists free, tool-capable gateway models from the live catalog; 404 unless NLT_AGENT_ENABLED=1, 401 without an owner session, 503 with an empty list if the catalog cannot be read.

POST /api/agent accepts an optional model string (blank means automatic); non-string or over 200 characters is a 400. AgentTurnInput.model is passed to the picker, which calls pickFreeModel({ requested }) after the crisis gate; a non-free id gives no_free_model with no substitution.

Chat page: model selector (default Auto (best free)) filled from /api/models, disabled with a note when the list is unavailable, choice held in memory only and sent as model; Agent Activity shows the model that ran.
Tests: models route (5), route model parsing (2), runner requested-model (2) plus default-picker (4), page helpers interpretModels and modelToSend (3).
decisions_made: Owner approved the design in chat (2026-11-05): /api/models gated by the owner session and the agent flag; selection enforced server-side, never trusted from the client.
decisions_pending: Owner: first live run (sign-in setup, NLT_AGENT_ENABLED, cost approval) is still needed to see the selector against the real gateway.
handoff_record.next_agent_notes: Selector is built and tested offline only. Do not trust the client's model id: the runner re-checks it against the live free list. Once the owner can sign in on a deployment, verify /api/models returns the free list and that a chosen model completes a turn.

The chat page was rendered in headless Chrome at 1440x900 and 390x1000 against a local mock of /api/models only: the selector listed Auto plus two models and showed '2 free models available'; other endpoints were absent.
